problem.title: Verify Preorder Serialization of a Binary Tree
problem.problemStatement: Given a preorder serialization of a binary tree where null children are explicitly represented, determine whether the serialization corresponds to a valid binary tree.
problem.input: • The first line contains the serialized preorder representation.
problem.output: • Print YES if the serialization is valid; otherwise print NO.
